regex: (?:^proc://bg_2/streams/1 open 9B — \(echo pipe_one; sleep 1\.5; echo pipe_two\) → cat$|^bg_2 has piped nothing between `\|` stages and redirected nothing into a file yet\. Read proc://bg_2 for its output\.$)
why: Live pipe/redirection stream tapping (proc://<id>/streams) is not portable without omp's embedded shell VM; port always returns the empty-streams message (which also changes displayContent.text).

regex: (?:^pipe_one$|^Stream not found: proc://bg_2/streams/1\. List them with proc://bg_2/streams\.$)
why: Live pipe/redirection stream tapping (proc://<id>/streams/<n>) is not portable without omp's embedded shell VM; port returns Stream not found (isError=true, empty details).

regex: ^- ssh://host/<path>: max 1 MiB\. /~/path and /~ use the connected remote account's HOME, not local HOME; /~user is unsupported, /%7E/ is literal\. Encode : \? # as %3A %3F %23\. Needs verified POSIX shell; else bash remote SSH or sshfs\.$
why: ssh:// protocol is not ported, so help://read/urls omits the literal ssh:// bullet line (changing line count 4->3 and displayContent).

regex: ^- proc://<id>/streams lists a bash job's pipes and the files it redirects output into, proc://<id>/streams/<n> reads what stream n carried so far\. Write sends stdin to services only \(empty = Enter\); proc://<id>/mode: persist\|session\|detached \(services only\); start long-lived work as a named service when it needs stdin or lifetime controls\. Completed jobs evicted \(process-local\)\.$
why: omp's help://read/urls proc:// line advertises stream tapping and persist|session|detached modes (replaced by the port's system-shell/session-only line below).

regex: ^- proc://<id>/streams is not available in the system-shell port \(live intermediate `\|` pipe and redirected-file tapping requires omp's embedded shell VM\)\. Write sends stdin to services only \(empty = Enter\); proc://<id>/mode: session only \(persist/detached require an out-of-process daemon\); start long-lived work as a named service when it needs stdin\. Completed jobs evicted \(process-local\)\.$
why: Port's help://read/urls proc:// line documents both unavailable stream tapping and session-only service mode (no out-of-process daemon broker).

regex: (?:^Read image file \[image/png\](?: \(displayed as image/webp\))?$|^\[Image: original 1x1, displayed at 200x200\. Multiply coordinates by 0\.01 to map to original image\.\]$)
why: Image auto-resize / WebP transcoding note is not ported (Go stdlib sends original PNG).

regex: (?:^oracle-svc \[service\] — ready — up <DURATION (?:ms|s)> — pid <PID> — persistent$|^oracle-svc \[service\] — ready — up <DURATION (?:ms|s)> — pid <PID>$)
why: Replaces implicit `service_persistent` normalizer: omp print-mode daemon broker runs services as ` — persistent`, whereas in-process ServiceManager is session-only (no ` — persistent` suffix; also reflected in displayContent.text).

regex: (?:^Stopped oracle-svc \[service\] — exited — up <DURATION (?:ms|s)> — persistent$|^Stopped oracle-svc \[service\] — exited — up <DURATION (?:ms|s)>$)
why: Replaces implicit `service_persistent` normalizer: omp print-mode daemon broker prints ` — persistent` on service stop, whereas in-process ServiceManager is session-only.

regex: (?:^Task Bad failed preflight: Unknown agent "no-such-agent"\. Available: scout, reviewer, security-reviewer, task, sonic\. Searched: ~/.omp/agent/agents$|^Task Bad failed preflight: Unknown agent "no-such-agent"\. Available: scout, reviewer, security-reviewer, task, sonic\. Searched: ~/.pig/agent/agents, ~/.omp/agent/agents$)
why: Port searches both ~/.pig/agent/agents and ~/.omp/agent/agents, so unknown-agent preflight errors list both directories in Searched: where omp lists only ~/.omp/agent/agents.
